title: Remove the Agentic OS web console (chat bridge, skill buttons, status bar, preview panel, launchers)
description: Human-directed (2026-07-01): retire the web console shipped in v0.5.0-v0.7.0. Remove the orchestrator chat bridge (src/orchestrator-bridge.js), skill-button catalog (src/skill-catalog.js), console shell UI, session status bar + mode badge/toggle UI, the app-preview panel (resolver/controller/routes/UI, TASK-065..069), the console.cmd/console.sh launchers, and the /hivemind:console and /hivemind:preview commands. KEEP: the kanban task board (/task-status) with drag-and-drop and the /graph view; the loop/mode/session-lock core (src/drive-loop.js, src/operating-mode.js, src/session-lock.js) which are console-independent. Update packaging (build entrypoints, plugin commands), the use-case manifest (console use cases removed - this IS a primary-surface change), docs and the orchestrator-routing skill (drop console/preview sections, keep loop/mode), and init materialization (no console launchers). NOTE: closing this makes TASK-072 (preview panel test coverage) obsolete.
acceptance_criteria: No console/preview surface remains: no /console or /preview plugin commands, no console.cmd/console.sh (source or init-materialized), no bridge/chat/skill/preview routes on the board server, no preview resolver/controller modules.
The kanban board (/task-status) and /graph view still work: board serves, drag-and-drop transitions persist, existing board specs green.
Loop, operating-mode, and session-lock modules are untouched and their specs green (mode toggle survives as API/CLI even though the console badge UI is gone).
Use-case manifest updated: console/preview use cases removed; tests/use-case-policy.spec.js green.

Packaging clean: build:plugin entrypoints updated, stale dist bundles removed, dist-parity green, claude plugin validate PASS, orchestrator-routing skill parity copies byte-identical with console/preview sections removed.
npm run test:all green after removal (obsolete console/preview specs deleted with their feature).
